scheme_name: Scholarship To Son And Daughter Of Differently Abled Persons
other_conditions: Must possess an identity card issued by the welfare board for the Differently Abled persons
Student must be studying from Standard 11th to Postgraduate level, including ITI/Polytechnic diploma courses and other higher education programs
benefits_summary: Provides scholarships ranging from Rs.1,000 to Rs.6,000 to sons and daughters of differently abled persons based on education level and hostel facility
documents_required: Identity card issued by the welfare board for the Differently Abled
